publicationText:
Three steps to a local SAP CAP API, using the checked-in inventory project.

1. Define Products with ID, title, and stock. Three sample products are already supplied.
2. Expose Products through an explicit InventoryService projection. This example is read-only.
3. Run npm run demo and open the displayed Products query. Filtering stock above zero returns Mechanical Keyboard and USB-C Dock.

The later full-list capture shows all three sample products, including the zero-stock monitor arm. It is not the filtered result.

Install the project's dependencies before following the video. This is a local development prototype with an in-memory SQLite database; authentication and deployment are separate work. The five live checks cover metadata, seeded rows, filtering, a missing product, and rejected writes.

Code and setup: Code link pending repository publication
SAP service guide: https://cap.cloud.sap/docs/guides/services/providing-services
SQLite development guide: https://cap.cloud.sap/docs/guides/databases/sqlite
